programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: A baby monkey finds a new mother and two serval cats are returned to the wild.

programme.title: Age of the Big Cats
programme.desc: The stories of the puma and the leopard, following their evolution and adaptation through the Ice Age and unravelling a story that spans two million years of history.

programme.title: Predators
programme.desc: In Zimbabwe, an African wild dog pack find themselves outnumbered by lions and hyenas, and the pups must learn quickly if the pack is to survive.

programme.title: Animals Like Us
programme.desc: Everyone helps with the upbringing of the little lion cubs in Kenya. Plus, a group of bees start a dance party.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School
programme.desc: Everyone is on edge as the team reunite reluctant mother Dilla with her new baby Delilah. Clara and Clarita go on their final journey.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Documentary following the work of dedicated staff at the RSPCA Hospital in Brisbane, Australia.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: A baby monkey finds a new mother and two serval cats are returned to the wild.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild
programme.desc: Two boisterous elephant babies begin to outgrow the Lilayi nursery, so the time comes for them to be relocated to Kafue National Park.

programme.title: Patrick Aryee's Wild World
programme.desc: In Costa Rica, insect numbers are in decline, so Patrick heads deep into the rainforest to find out just how far and wide this change is being felt.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs
programme.desc: Documentary about dogs that help humans in surprising ways, including a Great Dane that has helped a 13-year-old girl with a muscle-wasting condition to walk, swim and even ride a bike. In the first edition there is spectacular footage of caracals jumping three metres to catch flying birds, and a rare Bornean bay cat, which was thought to have been extinct. Patrick finds out how tigers made the transition from South-east Asia's steamy jungles to the -40C temperatures of Siberia, and meets 'lion whisperer' Kevin Richardson.

Finally, Patrick tells the story of the cat's domestication in Essaouira, Morocco, believed to be one of the first places where one particular species first gave up life in the wild in return for food, warmth, security and a home.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself.

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

Halford has visions of his dead wife, and becomes convinced he has been cursed, while Lane starts to suspect the killing may have been part of a human sacrifice. With guest star Stephanie Beacham.

programme.title: Nora Roberts' Blue Smoke
programme.desc: An arson investigator haunted by a traumatic childhood incident becomes the target of a stalker obsessed with fire. Thriller, with Alicia Witt and Scott Bakula.

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Sharon spreads her wings and takes full advantage of her sister's hospitality, but Tracey is having money worries. Ross Kemp guest stars, with Linda Robson and Pauline Quirke.

programme.title: Harry Wild
programme.desc: A body is pulled out of the river near Harry's local pub, and something about the dead man feels familiar to the sleuth. Harry and Fergus's investigation takes in the house of the grieving widow, a Polish restaurant, a boarding school and a greyhound track as they seek to uncover the sinister truth. Crime drama, starring Jane Seymour.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: A chance to buy goods from the comfort of home.

programme.title: Birds of a Feather
programme.desc: Tracey invites an old school friend to stay for a few days, leaving Sharon out in the cold. Comedy, starring Pauline Quirke and Linda Robson.

programme.title: Doctors
programme.desc: Desperate for a break from the monotony of academic life, a student impersonates her pizza-boy brother for a day. However, her quest for excitement goes awry, and Michelle is forced to come to her aid. Christine wakes after her operation, and Heston begins to feel redundant.

programme.title: Doctors
programme.desc: Heston tries to stop Christine when he realises she is planning to take Steven away from him, and a widow suffering from an STD goes on a quest to tell those who might be affected. Medical drama, starring Owen Brenman and Christine Kavanagh.

programme.title: Classic Holby City
programme.desc: Kyla's experiences with her son begin to affect her work when she is asked to look after a man facing up to the responsibility of caring for his dead sister's child. Connie reveals her jealousy of Clifford's loyalty toward Louise, while Mark is offered drugs on a night out.

programme.title: Casualty
programme.desc: A man with dementia is brought in after suffering a bump to the head, and after giving the staff the runaround he finally settles down thanks to Connie. But as his condition worsens, can she save him? Jeff and Tamzin are called out to a party where the boiler has exploded, putting intense pressure on an already busy department as an influx of revellers turn in the ED. Ethan and Rita suspect one of the partygoers of being bulimic, while a frustrated father is forced to leave without his ill son being seen.

programme.title: The Bill
programme.desc: Extended episode which sees DC Danny Glaze go undercover at a top-security prison to befriend a convicted bank robber, hoping to expose the brains behind the theft. He soon displays a flair for manipulating the warring factions among the inmates and eventually succeeds in winning the trust of his quarry - but gets caught up in an escape bid that rapidly degenerates into a tense hostage situation. Karl Collins stars.

programme.title: Classic EastEnders
programme.desc: Ben finally summons the courage to tell Phil the truth about recent events. A broken Michael tries to pick up the pieces of his life, turning to an unexpected person for help.

programme.title: Classic EastEnders
programme.desc: Zainab is left humiliated when Denise accidentally reveals all about her recent ordeal, and Yusef gets more than he bargained for when he arranges to meet up with a familiar face.

programme.title: Classic Neighbours
programme.desc: An angry Paul gives Shane a warning to stay away from his wife. Des announces a contest for 'Miss Pacific Bank'.

programme.title: Classic Neighbours
programme.desc: Excitement grips the Robinson household as Helen's marriage approaches. Paul becomes increasingly suspicious of Terry.

programme.title: Shakespeare & Hathaway: Private Investigators
programme.desc: When the duo are hired to help close down an old bingo hall, Frank is surprised to find an old enemy at work - but what is he really up to? Guest starring Jim Moir, aka Vic Reeves, with Mark Benton and Jo Joyner.

programme.title: Father Brown
programme.desc: A former music hall comedian swears revenge on the priest, leaving Father Brown trapped in a derelict building. Fifties-set crime drama, starring Mark Williams.

programme.title: Terry and June
programme.desc: The couple's new company car is stolen from the street, but is later returned together with an apology and two theatre tickets. However, it soon emerges the pair's problems are not yet over. John Junkin guest stars.

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.desc: Clegg, Truly, Alvin and Billy encounter a stranger who is determined to travel by canal to Ilkley in an inflatable swan. However, when punctures disrupt the man's dream, Entwistle is on hand to ensure the voyage goes to plan. Tommy Cannon and Bobby Ball guest star.

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.desc: Clegg climbs a tree to prove a point, but finds getting down is not as easy. Meanwhile, the police investigate the case of a runaway cooker. Comedy, starring Peter Sallis.

programme.title: Last of the Summer Wine
programme.sub-title: Has Anyone Seen a Peruvian Wart?
programme.desc: Roy Barraclough guest stars as Crowcroft, a well-known Lothario with a preference for gullible women. When he samples Nora Batty's baking, he decides to make her his next target. Long-running comedy, with Kathy Staff, Peter Sallis and Frank Thornton.

programme.title: The Brokenwood Mysteries
programme.desc: When four masked men attempt to rob the Brokenwood Savings Bank, Mike and the team must find out which one of them pulled the trigger that killed the bank manager. Detective drama set in a New Zealand town, starring Neill Rea, Fern Sutherland, Jarod Rawiri and Cristina Ionda.

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: The team reopens the 10-year-old murder of a librarian who also belonged to a witches' coven, and tries to track down the other members of the group. Halford has visions of his dead wife, and becomes convinced he has been cursed, while Lane starts to suspect the killing may have been part of a human sacrifice. With guest star Stephanie Beacham.

programme.title: Boyzone: The Final Concert
programme.desc: The Irish band's farewell performance at the Emirates Stadium in north London, celebrating their legacy and honouring former bandmate Stephen Gately, who died in 2009.

programme.title: Fatboy Slim: Right Here, Right Now
programme.desc: Documentary about the Big Beach Boutique II free event held in 2002, when an estimated quarter of a million people turned up to the concert on Brighton beach.

programme.title: Hitsville: The Making of Motown
programme.desc: Rare performances, interviews and rarely seen footage come together to paint a picture of the history and origins of the Motown record label.

programme.title: Nick Cave's Veiled World
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the creative universe, enduring influence and impact of the singer-songwriter and artist, whose legacy spans music, literature, film, and visual art. Contributors including musicians Florence Welch, Colin Greenwood and Warren Ellis, designer Bella Freud, film-maker Wim Wenders and writer Irvine Welsh discuss his influence on their own creative work.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of Italian film-maker Sergio Leone, whose influential movies include A Fistful of Dollars, The Good, the Bad and the Ugly and Once Upon a Time in America.

programme.title: Discovering: Robert De Niro
programme.desc: A profile of the American actor, who starred in Taxi Driver, Goodfellas and The King of Comedy and won Academy Awards for his roles in The Godfather Part II and Raging Bull.

programme.title: Discovering: Jeff Bridges
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the American actor, who starred in The Big Lebowski, Tron and True Grit and won an Oscar for his performance in Crazy Heart.

programme.title: Discovering: Sean Connery
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of the Scottish actor, who rose to fame as the original screen James Bond and won an Oscar for his role in The Untouchables.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of English film-maker Carol Reed, who directed movies including The Third Man, Odd Man Out and Our Man in Havana, and won an Oscar for 1968 musical Oliver!

programme.title: Rise of the Superheroes
programme.desc: A look at how the tales of comic book superheroes like Batman and the Avengers were adapted for cinema before going on to dominate Hollywood and captivate audiences worldwide.

programme.title: Jackie Stewart
programme.desc: Documentary about Formula 1 great Jackie Stewart, from his humble beginnings outside Glasgow to winning three World Drivers' Championships.

programme.title: I Am Paul Walker
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the life and legacy of American actor Paul Walker, who rose to fame in the Fast and Furious franchise, but died at the age of 40 after a car crash.

programme.title: Be Water
programme.desc: A look at Bruce Lee's time in Hong Kong making four films, exploring questions of identity and representation through rare archive, intimate interviews, and Lee's writings.

programme.title: Bruno v Tyson
programme.desc: The story of the boxing rivalry between Frank Bruno and Mike Tyson, spanning two epic fights marred by politics and volatile race relations, with the old foes coming together for a reunion.

programme.title: My Icon: Duke McKenzie
programme.desc: The former world champion boxer talks about the individuals that have been an inspiration to him over the course of his career.

programme.title: Rik Mayall: Magnificent B'stard
programme.desc: A documentary tribute to the influential and much-missed comedian, a man driven by punk spirit and an unrelenting commitment to pushing boundaries. When he died in 2014 at the age of 56, Rik left behind a body of ground-breaking work, from Rick the Poet and Kevin Turvey to The Young Ones, Bottom and The New Statesman - performances that redefined television comedy and helped ignite the alternative comedy revolution. The film explores his comedic journey, his creative partnership with Adrian Edmondson, his struggle with drink and the near-fatal quad-bike accident that left him fighting not only for his life but also his future. Contributors include Stephen Fry, Ben Elton, Greg Davies, Paul Jackson, John Lloyd, Nigel Planer and Adrian Edmondson.

programme.title: God Bless Ozzy Osbourne
programme.desc: A profile of Black Sabbath member Ozzy Osbourne, from the wild and hedonistic days that adversely affected his personal life, through the years of depression, alcoholism and drug dependency that followed. The programme also reveals how he overcame his demons, with the help of his second wife Sharon. Featuring interviews with Paul McCartney, Motley Crue drummer Tommy Lee and others.

programme.title: Tina
programme.desc: Born Anna Mae Bullock in 1939, Tina Turner has sold in excess of 100 million records and earned numerous plaudits including Grammy awards and induction into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame with her first husband, Ike Turner. She was the first woman to grace the cover of Rolling Stone magazine and dabbled in acting including a memorable performance opposite Mel Gibson in Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome. Following a prolonged period of ill health, Turner intends to retire from the spotlight with her second husband, Erwin Bach. She bids farewell to her fans in the emotional documentary Tina. Directed by Dan Lindsay and TJ Martin, the film invites the singer to reminisce about her turbulent life and career with glowing contributions from friends, family and fans including Oprah Winfrey and Angela Bassett.

programme.title: Jealous Guy: The Assassination of John Lennon
programme.desc: An exploration of the life and career of the Beatles superstar, with a look at the strange parallels between him and his killer Mark David Chapman.

programme.title: Terry Venables: A Man Can Dream
programme.desc: A look at the life and times of the former footballer and manager, who died in November 2023, intertwined with the story of England's unforgettable run at Euro 96, with insight from players, friends and family.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of John Frankenheimer, who directed films including Birdman of Alcatraz, The Manchurian Candidate, French Connection II, Black Sunday and Ronin.

programme.title: Discovering: Robin Williams
programme.desc: A profile of the American actor and comedian, who starred in Good Morning, Vietnam and Dead Poets Society and won an Oscar for his role in Good Will Hunting.

programme.title: Discovering: Robert De Niro
programme.desc: A profile of the American actor, who starred in Taxi Driver, Goodfellas and The King of Comedy and won Academy Awards for his roles in The Godfather Part II and Raging Bull.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of Italian film-maker Sergio Leone, whose influential movies include A Fistful of Dollars, The Good, the Bad and the Ugly and Once Upon a Time in America.

programme.title: Lancaster
programme.desc: The story of the bomber synonymous with the Dambusters, the night raids against Germany and the brave men and women who made them possible.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: The story of the British single-seat fighter plane the Supermarine Spitfire, designed by RJ Mitchell and famous for its role in the Battle of Britain. Archive footage, new film of the aircraft in flight and interviews with the last surviving veterans who flew the plane in combat combine to tell its story.

programme.title: The Commandant's Shadow
programme.desc: Documentary following the son of the man who was in charge of Auschwitz concentration camp as he confronts his father's involvement in the murder of more than a million Jews.

programme.title: When We Were Kings
programme.desc: Leon Gast's Oscar-winning documentary charting the challenge of an ageing Muhammad Ali for George Foreman's World Heavyweight title held in Zaire in 1974. The film explores the impact of Ali's visit to Africa before focusing on the epic fight, dubbed the 'Rumble in the Jungle', which has gone down in history as one of the greatest of all time. Spike Lee and Norman Mailer are among the contributors offering personal opinions on its importance to them.

programme.title: My Icon: Johnny Nelson (Pt1)
programme.desc: The former world champion boxer discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and career. Part 1.

programme.title: Apollo 11
programme.desc: Documentary made to mark the 50th anniversary of the moon landings, presenting the story of the iconic space mission through a newly discovered trove of 70mm archive footage and still photographs and drawing on thousands of hours of audio recordings. Featuring the personal accounts of the astronauts, the team in Mission Control, and the millions of spectators on the ground.

programme.title: My Icon: Leon Pryce
programme.desc: The former Bradford Bulls and St Helens star discusses the individuals that have inspired him in his life and sporting career.

programme.title: My Mom Jayne
programme.desc: Actress Mariska Hargitay explores the life of her mother Jayne Mansfield, who died in a car accident at the age of 34 when Mariska was only three years old. Through intimate interviews and a collection of never-before-seen photos and home movies, the Law & Order: Special Victims Unit star grapples with her mother's public and private legacy and discovers the layers and depth of who she was, not only to her audience but to those who were closest to her.

programme.title: Gary
programme.desc: A look at the life and mysterious death of actor Gary Coleman, who shot to fame as Arnold in hit sitcom Diff'rent Strokes.

programme.title: Belushi
programme.desc: The life story of comedy star John Belushi, who captured the hearts and funny-bones of audiences worldwide before his tragic and untimely death aged 33.

programme.title: I Am Burt Reynolds
programme.desc: Family and friends of the iconic Hollywood actor come together to share memories of his life and fruitful career, from its beginnings in Old Hollywood through to breakout roles in Deliverance and The Longest Yard, to the smash hit, Smokey and the Bandit and on to Boogie Nights.

programme.title: Surviving Ohio State
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the scandal surrounding athletics doctor Richard Strauss, whose two-decade tenure at Ohio State University saw the sexual abuse of hundreds of students.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: The life and work of Alan J Pakula, who directed films including Klute, The Parallax View, All the President's Men, Sophie's Choice and Presumed Innocent.

programme.title: The Guest Wing
programme.desc: Documentary following stately home owners who hire out their estates to earn extra income, and the clients who pay to use their properties for functions including stag parties, weddings and hunting trips. The programme explores how the reality of life in Britain's grand houses is often less glamorous than it appears, as proprietors struggle to maintain crumbling buildings and pay utility bills, and examines the modern-day divide between domestic staff and their employers. Featuring life at Chillingham Castle, Maunsel House, Carlton Towers and Muncaster Castle.

programme.title: Discovering: Alain Delon
programme.desc: A profile of the French actor, who worked with directors including Luchino Visconti, Jean-Luc Godard, Jean-Pierre Melville, Michelangelo Antonioni and Louis Malle.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of American director and screenwriter Spike Lee, whose films include Do the Right Thing, Malcolm X, Summer of Sam and BlacKkKlansman.

programme.title: The 2010s
programme.desc: A look at Barack Obama's presidency and the seismic political shifts that took place in both the Republican and Democratic parties during that time.

programme.title: Branson
programme.desc: Profile of Richard Branson. The first episode reveals how he quit school and embarked on an entrepreneurial journey that led to incredible riches.

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming explores the history of Bristol, beginning by learning a grisly secret at the docks before meeting Mercury Prize-winning musician Roni Size to discuss life in the St Pauls and Stokes Croft areas of the city. He also explores the district of Clifton and visits a speakeasy-style bar.

programme.title: Man on Wire
programme.desc: Oscar-winning documentary about French street performer Philippe Petit. In 1974 he undertook a daring 45-minute tightrope walk and acrobatic routine on a wire stretched between the two towers of the World Trade Centre. Featuring re-creations of his earlier stunts at Paris's Notre Dame cathedral and Sydney Harbour Bridge.

programme.title: The Kid Stays in the Picture
programme.desc: Film producer Robert Evans narrates this documentary chronicling the ups and downs of his extraordinary life. Among the topics covered are his big break into the movie industry, his failed marriage to Ali McGraw, his relationships with Grace Kelly and Ava Gardner, his descent into drug addiction, and his journey back to respectability. With contributions by friends and family, and including footage of a host of Hollywood legends.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: A look at the life and career of American director and screenwriter Spike Lee, whose films include Do the Right Thing, Malcolm X, Summer of Sam and BlacKkKlansman.

programme.title: Discovering: Alain Delon
programme.desc: A profile of the French actor, who worked with directors including Luchino Visconti, Jean-Luc Godard, Jean-Pierre Melville, Michelangelo Antonioni and Louis Malle.

programme.title: Lost Grounds
programme.desc: Fat Boy Slim reveals what he likes most about Brighton's old stadiums. Plus, visits to the Dell and the Den, and a visit to an abandoned amusement arcade in Southend.

programme.title: I Am Steve McQueen
programme.desc: The life and career of the American actor, who starred in The Thomas Crown Affair, The Getaway, Papillon, The Magnificent Seven, The Great Escape and The Towering Inferno. Featuring contributions by his son Chad, grandson Steven and granddaughter Molly, as well as ex-wives Neile Adams McQueen and Ali MacGraw and widow Barbara Minty McQueen.

programme.title: Salt Path: A Very British Scandal
programme.desc: A look at Observer journalist Chloe Hadjimatheou's investigation into allegations of factual inaccuracies in Raynor Winn's book The Salt Path.

programme.title: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
programme.desc: A look at the nerve agent attack on former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia in Salisbury, with contributions from intelligence and counterterrorism officials, journalists and victims. The film uncovers how authorities raced to identify the perpetrators, contain a deadly chemical weapon and respond to one of the most brazen acts of state-sponsored aggression on British soil.

programme.title: The Thin Blue Line
programme.desc: Film-maker Errol Morris's documentary presenting a reconstructive study that succeeded in proving the innocence of a man being held on death row following his conviction of the murder of a Dallas policeman in 1976.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Blue Oranges
programme.desc: When a wealthy alcoholic turns up dead, Detective Nilesh investigates the murder by interrogating various suspects that include her former lover, a spoilt brat and the commissioner's brother.

programme.title: Kahani Kismat Ki
programme.desc: A reformed man tries to make an honest living for himself and his family after his jail term. His life takes an ugly turn when a woman claims him to be her husband and he is also framed for murder.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Antardwand

programme.title: Aar Ya Paar
programme.desc: Shekhar is having an affair with Anu, his wealthy wife's secretary. When the wife finds out, they kill her. The police then find evidence against him, and he learns that Anu is likely to betray him.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat

programme.title: Daraar
programme.desc: Raj Malhotra, a wealthy man, falls in love with Priya Bhatia, a real estate agent, as soon as he meets her. When he proposes to her for marriage, he discovers that she is already married.

programme.title: Sultanat
programme.desc: Sultan, a brave warrior, tries to win the affections of Yasmin, a beautiful woman. However, his life turns upside-down when his father is killed by a general who he then swears revenge against.

programme.title: Shiva Shakti
programme.desc: Shiva forms a close friendship with Shakti when he comes to the city to earn money for his sister Kusum's wedding. However, he later vows to kill Shakti when Kusum becomes pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: Pyaar Ka Safar
programme.desc: Bharath has lost everything since his childhood including his love. He is supported by his childhood friend Bhargava. Does Bhargava help him or will he end up destroying him completely.

programme.title: Hiraasat

programme.title: Jagan
programme.desc: Jagan, an artist by profession, befriends two siblings on separate occasions and they both fall in love with him. He is forcibly married to the elder sister by goons, creating troubles in his life.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Taqdeer Ka Tamasha
programme.desc: An officer shares a strained relationship with his brother Satya, a criminal. When he tries to collect evidence against a goon, he meets his sibling. But they are not aware of the gangster's secrets.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal

programme.title: Dhadkan
programme.desc: Anjali and Dev are in love with each other and plan to marry, but her family gets her married to Ram. Years later, Dev shows up to reunite with Anjali, however, she has fallen in love with Ram.

programme.title: Baadshah
programme.desc: Raj, a small-time private detective who is desperate for a big break, gets drawn into a political conspiracy when he is hired to rescue a hostage.

programme.title: Ram Balram
programme.desc: Jagatpal raises his nephews, Ram and Balram, after killing their parents. He hatches an evil plan to push Ram into the world of smuggling and earn money, but the brothers unite to take him down.

programme.title: Anari Ishq
programme.desc: Rama, a simpleton, is appointed as the bodyguard of Rajnandini, a rich girl. She soon falls in love with him but her brothers' violent nature gets in the way of her uniting with Rama.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
programme.desc: Amnesiac rogue assassin Jason Bourne's long-buried memories are reawakened by a British journalist researching the secret organisation that was responsible for transforming him into a killing machine. Meanwhile, a ruthless CIA director becomes convinced Bourne is still a security risk, and plans to dispose of him once and for all. Third instalment of the spy thriller series, directed by Paul Greengrass and starring Matt Damon, Joan Allen, Julia Stiles, David Strathairn, Paddy Considine, Scott Glenn and Albert Finney.

programme.title: The Bourne Legacy
programme.desc: The leaders of a secret government agency plan to eliminate several agents as part of a cover-up when they face having their dark secrets exposed. One of the targets is able to evade his fate and go on the run - but his escape is threatened by his dependence on drugs to boost his physical and mental capabilities. Spy thriller sequel, with Jeremy Renner, Rachel Weisz and Edward Norton.

programme.title: Jason Bourne
programme.desc: Former government operative Jason Bourne has been in hiding for 12 years after exposing a sinister CIA operation. However, he once again finds himself being hunted down when a former CIA operative gone rogue acquires top secret information - including details of Bourne's own father's involvement in a clandestine scheme. Action thriller, starring Matt Damon, Tommy Lee Jones, Alicia Vikander and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: The Bourne Identity
programme.desc: A fishing boat crew plucks a man out of the sea with two bullet wounds in his back and a safety-deposit number sewn into his skin - but absolutely no memory of who he is or how he got there. In the search for his true identity, he is pursued by assassins - but his skill at evading them suggests his own past is far from straightforward. Thriller, starring Matt Damon, Franka Potente, Chris Cooper, Clive Owen and Brian Cox.

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy
programme.desc: The amnesiac assassin is living quietly in hiding, until his former employers come after him again and murder his girlfriend. A CIA operation has ended in disaster, and those responsible intend to clear their names by implicating Bourne. As the former secret agent tries to evade the hitmen on his trail, he also struggles to piece together the truth about his past. Action thriller sequel, starring Matt Damon, Brian Cox, Joan Allen and Julia Stiles.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The masked avenger stalks the streets of Gotham City, waging a nightly war against the criminal element. However, he may have met his match when the city's crime syndicate is taken over by the crazed Joker, who plans to poison the populace with toxic chemicals. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure, starring Michael Keaton, Jack Nicholson and Kim Basinger.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: The masked hero returns to face the Penguin, a grotesque crime boss dwelling in the sewers who conspires with a corrupt businessman to make himself mayor. When the tycoon tries to kill his secretary, she returns as vengeful vigilante Catwoman, who soon forms an intense relationship with the dark knight in both their costumed and real identities. Tim Burton's comic-book adventure sequel, starring Michael Keaton, Danny DeVito and Michelle Pfeiffer.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: The masked crimefighter takes on the twin threats of disfigured maniac Two-Face and insane genius the Riddler, who are plotting to control the brains of the entire world. Meanwhile, an acrobat whose family has been murdered by Two-Face steps up to join Batman in his fight against evil. Superhero adventure sequel, starring Val Kilmer, Tommy Lee Jones, Nicole Kidman, Jim Carrey and Chris O'Donnell.

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: The caped crusader and his sidekick take on the villainous Mr Freeze, who plans to destroy Gotham City with an icy doomsday weapon unless his demands are met. The dynamic duo also have to contend with femme fatale Poison Ivy, who is determined to drive a wedge between them. Comic-book adventure, starring George Clooney, Arnold Schwarzenegger, Uma Thurman and Chris O'Donnell.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.title: Smerconish
programme.desc: After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

It's up to Arthur, Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

programme.desc: The Grinch and his loyal dog, Max, live a solitary existence inside a cave on Mount Crumpet. His main source of aggravation comes during Christmastime when his neighbours in Whoville celebrate the holidays with a bang. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realises there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all.

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Finding out that he's actually human, Buddy the elf leaves the North Pole to find his real dad in bustling New York, but when he gets there, his mean old dad doesn't want to know. programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million worth of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: The intrepid explorer Indiana Jones sets out to rescue his father, a medievalist who has vanished while searching for the Holy Grail. Following clues in the old man's notebook, Indy arrives in Venice, where he enlists the help of a beautiful academic, but they are not the only ones who are on the trail, and some sinister old enemies soon come out of the woodwork.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

programme.desc: Diving into a world of some unmissable Sky Original films, from the psychological thriller 'To Catch a Killer' to the Academy Award-nominated 'The United States vs Billie Holiday'.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.

programme.title: Rumble in the Bronx
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop on holiday in New York puts his martial arts skills to good use when he helps out a friend whose shop is targeted by a vicious street gang. Martial arts hero Jackie Chan, as always, does all his own stunts.

However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.title: Jaws III
programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

programme.title: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
programme.desc: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

programme.desc: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.

programme.title: Addams Family Values
programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.

programme.title: Fox and Hare Save the Forest
programme.desc: One day, Fox and Hare discover that Owl has disappeared. They go looking for him in the forest with all their friends and discover a big lake that wasn't there before. It is the beginning of an exciting and funny adventure.

programme.title: Wallace & Gromit in The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
programme.desc: Story of the chase for a giant rabbit terrorising a town's allotments and vegetable patches days before the annual vegetable-growing competition. As Wallace and his trusty companion are called into action with their pest control business, a dastardly Lord Victor Quartermaine competes to capture the Were-Rabbit and win the heart of a beautiful lady.

programme.title: Antz
programme.desc: A neurotic ant struggles to express his individuality in a colony of conformists. He attempts to break from his totalitarian society while at the same time trying to win the affection of the princess he loves.

programme.title: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
programme.desc: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.

programme.title: How to Train Your Dragon
programme.desc: On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

programme.title: The LEGO NINJAGO Movie
programme.desc: Master Wu, who is as wise-cracking as he is wise, leads a fierce team of secret ninja warriors to defeat the evil warlord Garmadon and save Ninjago City. He will need all of his cunning and guile to defeat his enemy.

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip
programme.desc: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.

programme.title: A Minecraft Movie

programme.title: The Bourne Supremacy

Kirill begins to pursue Bourne, intending to assassinate him, but while Bourne and his girlfriend, Marie, are on the run, a shot meant for him kills her instead. Vowing revenge, Bourne sets out to prove his innocence and bring the culprits to justice, but he has to evade CIA head Pamela Landry, who is convinced he is guilty.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky.

programme.title: Batman Returns
programme.desc: After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.

programme.title: Batman Forever
programme.desc: DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?

programme.title: Batman & Robin
programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.

programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview
programme.desc: Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.

programme.title: Mad Max
programme.desc: In a desolate near future, vicious motorcycle gangs roam the wastelands attacking what is left of civilisation. With law and order in chaos, a tough police patrolman enforces a new kind of law - cold-blooded revenge - when his family is murdered by one of the gangs.

programme.title: Mad Max 2: The Road Warrior
programme.desc: Fast-paced apocalyptic adventure. In a hostile post-World War III world, petrol is the most precious commodity and people will do anything to get it. Embittered lone warrior Max agrees to help when an oil-producing community comes under attack from a violent gang determined to get its hands on their fuel.

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
programme.desc: Set in a lawless, post-apocalyptic wilderness. To retrieve his camel train, hero Max enters the seedy, savage, rough-hewn precincts of Bartertown. Forced to fight for his possessions, he breaks the only rule of the city and is banished. In the desert, he is rescued by a tribe of feral children who see him as a prophesied saviour.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.

programme.title: A Clockwork Orange
programme.desc: In an England of the future, Alex de Large is the leader of a gang of droogs whose pastime is violence, sex and murder, but whose eventual punishment is almost as extreme and violent as his crimes. Betrayed by the other members of his gang, he is arrested and offered an experimental treatment in order to shorten his sentence.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Epic Storytelling
programme.desc: This week's edition of the Cinema List is all about epic storytelling. From The Shawshank Redemption to Dunkirk, witness unforgettable tales of hope, courage and survival.

programme.title: The Towering Inferno
programme.desc: At the opening party of a colossal, but poorly constructed office building, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike
programme.desc: A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.

programme.title: First Blood
programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.

programme.title: Bad Boys
programme.desc: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million worth of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: The intrepid explorer Indiana Jones sets out to rescue his father, a medievalist who has vanished while searching for the Holy Grail. Following clues in the old man's notebook, Indy arrives in Venice, where he enlists the help of a beautiful academic, but they are not the only ones who are on the trail, and some sinister old enemies soon come out of the woodwork.

programme.title: Army of Darkness
programme.desc: Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

programme.title: Jackie Chan's First Strike

programme.title: Clear and Present Danger
programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.

programme.title: The Cinema List: Unmissable Sky Originals
programme.desc: Diving into a world of some unmissable Sky Original films, from the psychological thriller 'To Catch a Killer' to the Academy Award-nominated 'The United States vs Billie Holiday'.

programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.

programme.title: Shenandoah
programme.desc: A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.

programme.title: Rumble in the Bronx
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop on holiday in New York puts his martial arts skills to good use when he helps out a friend whose shop is targeted by a vicious street gang. Martial arts hero Jackie Chan, as always, does all his own stunts.

programme.desc: Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

programme.title: Jaws 2
programme.desc: Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

programme.title: Jaws III
programme.desc: Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.

programme.title: Breitscheidplatz 19/12
programme.desc: Eine Razzia gegen Islamisten steht bevor. Laudin (Albrecht Schuch) bleibt nur wenig Zeit, um vorher Belastbares in die Hand zu bekommen – denn danach muss sein Informant abtauchen. Cem (Tamer Trasoglu) schlägt einen Waffendeal vor, um den "Emir" (Ibtasamm Shah) und seine Gefolge in eine Straftat zu verwickeln. Der Informant weiß um sein Risiko – und verlangt von Laudin einen Schwur. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Breitscheidplatz 19/12
programme.desc:
Beim LKA knallen die Sektkorken: Durch den Kronzeugen (Doguhan Kabadayi) werden IS-Strukturen zerschlagen – und führende Köpfe verhaftet.

Doch der Zorn des „Emirs“ (Ibtasamm Shah) bringt jenen in Todesgefahr, von dem er sich verraten fühlt – selbst im Zeugenschutz. Dass Laudin (Albrecht Schuch) sein Versprechen nicht halten konnte, belastet den erfolgreichen Staatsschützer.

Obwohl der Beamte weiter vor Anis (Wael Alkhatib) warnt, kann dieser im Dezember 2016 unbehelligt seinen Anschlag vorbereiten … (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Novemberliebe – Eine St. Martins Geschichte
programme.desc: Darunter auch traumatisierte Bundeswehroffiziere wie Henrik, dem diese Therapie dienstlich verordnet wird. Er tut sich anfangs mit seinem Pferd Fideo sehr schwer. Doch Anja hilft ihm, sich zu öffnen – und dabei kommen sich beide näher… \n\nMan muss schon etwas Kitsch aushalten können, um sich ganz auf diese Liebesgeschichte einzulassen. Wer das kann, entdeckt im Spiel von Bettina Zimmermann und Tobias van Dieken eine verletzliche Intimität, die unverhofft zu rühren weiß.

programme.title: Deutschlandbilder
programme.desc:
„Deutschlandbilder“ lädt zu einer stimmungsvollen Reise zu den schönsten Regionen des Landes ein.

Eindrucksvolle Aufnahmen zeigen abwechslungsreiche Landschaften, historische Städte, malerische Inseln und reizvolle Naturkulissen in ihrer ganzen Vielfalt.

Die Sendung vermittelt faszinierende Eindrücke von bekannten Sehenswürdigkeiten ebenso wie von weniger entdeckten Orten.

So entsteht ein abwechslungsreiches Porträt Deutschlands, das zum Entdecken, Staunen und Verweilen einlädt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Kurz nach dem Verschwinden Celine Bergers gibt ihr Mann Entwarnung. Angeblich hat seine Frau ihn angerufen, was Finn und Lars bezweifeln. Denn die Ermittler haben mittlerweile herausgefunden, dass die Vermisste eine Affäre hatte ….

programme.title: Arthur und die Freunde der Tafelrunde
programme.desc:
Igraine kann beweisen, dass sie die rechtmäßige Thronfolgerin ist. Ein Dokument, versehen mit dem Siegel der Kobolde, zeigt den entsprechenden Stammbaum.

Merlin widerspricht und unterstreicht, dass der Thronfolger in der Lage sein muss, Excalibur aus dem Stein zu ziehen.

Igraine muss passen. Das magische Schwert bewegt sich kein Stück.

Anders bei Arthur, der die Klinge spielend aus dem Stein zieht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Arthur und die Freunde der Tafelrunde
programme.desc:
Mit einem magischen Dolch hat Mordred Merlins Baum vergiftet und bringt damit Schloss Camelot in Gefahr. Niemand kann den Dolch aus dem Baum herausziehen, ohne sich selbst daran zu vergiften.

Arthur und Morgan stellen Mordred nach und finden heraus, dass sich der Dolch mit einem magischen Handschuh berühren lässt. Doch Mordred vernichtet den Handschuh vor ihren Augen.

Glücklicherweise finden Arthur und Morgan einen Hinweis. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Dein großer Tag
programme.desc: Der zehnjährige Julian hat einen besonderen Wunsch: Endlich mit einem richtig coolen Motorrad fahren. Am besten ein Rennen auf einer Motocross-Strecke. Julian wird von einem echten Profi, dem mehrmaligen Deutschen Motocross-Meister Bernd Eckenbach, trainiert. Am Ende wartet dann seine große Challenge: ein Rennen. Ob Julian gewinnen kann? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Elefant, Tiger & Kids: Zoo-Praktikum Backstage
programme.desc: Zurück in Leipzig! "Elefant, Tiger & Kids" kehrt in die Zoo-Homebase zurück und es geht gleich krass nass los! 70 Kois ziehen um. Wow! Was für ein Tier-Umzug! Die Lippenbärin wird mit Honig überrascht und die "ETK"-Teens bauen eine coole Chillout-Area für die Bärin zum Abhängen. Unsere jungen Helfer sind mittendrin im tierischen Neustart! Sei auch du dabei! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Elefant, Tiger & Kids: Zoo-Praktikum Backstage
programme.desc:
Spielerisch checken die Zoo-Praktikanten, wie schnell sie unter Zeitdruck arbeiten können. Gleichzeitig müssen sie Teamgeist beweisen.

Für Lippenbärin Rachana im Zoo Leipzig gibt's eine „Snack-Bär-Überraschung“.

Und unsere Zoo-Helfer testen: Wer hat mehr „Brain“? Wessen Hände zittern am wenigsten? Und wem geht die Luft zuerst aus?

Wenn die „Fetzen“ fliegen, bleibt kein Auge trocken. Sei dabei, wenn unsere Praktikanten über sich hinauswachsen! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Shaun das Schaf
programme.desc: Kaum ist der Bauer aus dem Haus, feiert Bitzer mit Shaun und den Schafen eine wilde Party im Wohnzimmer. Doch das dicke Ende kommt erst: Am nächsten Morgen droht die hinterhältige Mieze Pidsley, dem Bauern Beweisfotos zuzuspielen! Shaun und Bitzer setzen alles daran, der Katze die Fotos abzuluchsen, um der Erpressung ein Ende zu bereiten. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Pia und die wilde Natur
programme.desc:
Pia ist fasziniert vom indischen Mangrovenwald: Tiger, Affen, an Land lebende Fische und Pflanzen, die im Salzwasser wachsen. Ein abenteuerlicher Lebensraum!

Tierreporterin Pia ist heute mit dem Boot unterwegs im größten Mangrovengebiet der Welt: den Sundarbans in Indien. Auf der Bootssafari erfährt sie, dass es hier schwimmende Tiger gibt.

Sie ist auf der Suche nach einem riesigen Krokodil, muss einer vom Aussterben bedrohten Schildkrötenart helfen und lernen, wie ein Schlammspringer hüpft. Ob ihr das gelingt? Seht selbst! (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Anna und die Haustiere
programme.desc:
Anna besucht zwei Hunde, die vorübergehend bei einer Pflegestelle leben und auf der Suche nach einem neuen Zuhause sind.

Immer mehr Hunde werden von Tierschutzorganisationen vermittelt. Bevor sie ihr neues Zuhause finden, leben viele bei einer Pflegestelle, also bei Menschen, die sie vorübergehend aufnehmen, versorgen und auf ihr neues Leben vorbereiten.

Anna besucht Angelika, die schon vielen Hunden ein Zuhause auf Zeit gegeben hat. Momentan leben die große Jara und Jungspund Timmy bei ihr.

Anna übt mit Timmy erste Kommandos und erlebt, warum Staubsauger-Training genauso wichtig ist wie Gassigehen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Checker Tobi
programme.desc:
Tobi findet heraus, warum wir Zahlen brauchen, was es mit der Erfindung der Null auf sich hat und wie groß unendlich ist.

Zahlen sind überall: beim Einkaufen, in der Musik, auf Spielplätzen und Brücken. Tobi entdeckt mit Ingenieurin Anna versteckte Zahlen in unserem Alltag und checkt, warum ohne sie nichts funktionieren würde.

Er findet heraus, warum unser Zahlensystem so genial ist und was die Null damit zu tun hat. Außerdem geht's um Rechnen und um die ganz große Frage: Wie groß ist eigentlich unendlich? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Wissen macht Ah!
programme.desc:
Clarissa und Tarkan sind heute ganz schön empfindlich.

Im „Wissen macht Ah!“-Studio ist es heiß, Tarkans Shirt kratzt und beim Lüften fliegt alles durcheinander. So können die beiden nicht arbeiten. Und woher kommt eigentlich dieses nervige Fiepen?

Wie kann man versuchen, entspannt zu bleiben, wenn um einen herum alles chaotisch ist? Kann die richtige Atemübung helfen? Tarkan und Clarissa machen den Selbstversuch.

Außerdem gibt's die Antworten auf die fünf Fragen der Sendung:

Warum zuckt man beim Einschlafen?

Kurz bevor man ganz entspannt in den Schlaf fällt, zuckt der Körper und man schreckt hoch. Das ist zwar nervig, aber meist harmlos. Fast 70 Prozent der Menschen kennen diese sogenannten „Hypnic Jerks“ – also das plötzliche Zucken beim Einschlafen. Aber was genau löst sie aus und kann man das verhindern? Clarissa kennt die Antwort.

Gibt es das Bauchgefühl? (Sollte man auf seinen Bauch hören?)

Wann fühlt man einen „Kloß im Hals“?

Wie funktioniert eine VR-Brille?

Was passiert bei einem Wachstumsschub? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: POV – Deine Geschichte zählt
programme.sub-title: Führerschein – Was hilft bei Angst vor der Fahrprüfung?
programme.desc:
Nach der ersten Führerscheinprüfung durchgefallen: Josie kämpft mit Prüfungsangst, Leistungsdruck und der Sorge, erneut zu scheitern.

Josie ist bei ihrer ersten Führerschein-Theorieprüfung durchgefallen. Seitdem ist der Druck groß: Während ihre Freundinnen und Freunde den Führerschein schon haben, kämpft sie mit Prüfungsangst, Schulstress und der Sorge, erneut zu scheitern. Denn jeder weitere Versuch kostet Geld.

Im Reportageformat „POV – Deine Geschichte zählt“ begleitet Host Noel Josie bei einer Fahrstunde und geht der Frage nach, wie Prüfungsangst entsteht und was dagegen hilft.

Dann werden die Rollen getauscht: Josie wird zur Prüferin und Noel muss zeigen, ob er seine praktische Fahrprüfung heute nochmal bestehen würde. Doch wie schlägt er sich unter Prüfungsdruck? Und was kann Josie aus diesem Perspektivwechsel für ihre eigene Prüfung mitnehmen? (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Nils Holgerssons wunderbare Reise (1/4) – Der Aufbruch
programme.desc: Der 13-jährige Nils ist nicht besonders glücklich: Ständig muss er auf dem Bauernhof seiner Eltern helfen, dabei ginge er viel lieber mit dem Vater auf die Fuchsjagd. Doch der wird ihn nicht mitnehmen, denn Nils hat vergessen, die Milch auszutragen – und überhaupt sind seine Eltern der Meinung, er sei faul, habe keinen Respekt vor den Tieren und viel Unsinn im Kopf. \n\nNur Åsa, die Tochter des Apothekers, versteht ihn und hält zu ihm, bis sie eines Tages, als Nils' Eltern in die Stadt gefahren sind, erleben muss, wie Nils einen Raben sehr unsanft verscheucht.

programme.title: Panda, Gorilla & Co.
programme.sub-title: Geschichten aus dem Zoo Berlin und dem Tierpark Berlin
programme.desc:
Tierarzt Dr. Andreas Ochs hat heute wieder alle Hände voll zu tun: Wasserbock-Weibchen „Mäuschen“ hat Probleme mit den Zähnen und benötigt dringend ein Antibiotikum. Ein vier Wochen altes Küken bei den Grönland-Blessgänsen atmet verdächtig schwer, und bei den Elefanten-Kühen steht die 14-tägliche Blutabnahme an, die einer wissenschaftlichen Untersuchung über den Herpesvirus dient.

Auch die Gorilla-Damen Bibi, Djambala und Mpenzi hatten über Monate an einer Untersuchung teilgenommen. Um zu klären, warum es bei Ivo und seinen Damen mit dem Nachwuchs nicht klappt, wollte man wissen, ob die Affenweibchen überhaupt einen Zyklus haben. Dazu wurde ihnen regelmäßig Urin abgenommen. Nun liegen die Ergebnisse aus dem Primatenzentrum vor.

Über zu wenig Nachwuchs in seinem Revier kann sich Tierpfleger René Walther nicht beklagen. Die Bilanz dieser Saison: drei Lämmer bei den Langohrziegen, die heute das letzte Mal Muttermilch genießen dürfen, drei Jungtiere bei den Schneeziegen und zwei Kälber bei den Gold-Takinen, die mittlerweile mit den weißen Bergziegen die Anlage getauscht haben.

Auch Alpaka-Dame „Lütte“ ist Mutter geworden. Aus diesem Anlass schaut die Sängerin und Schauspielerin Angelika Mann im Kamelrevier vorbei. Alpaka „Lütte“ ist seit 2006 ihr Patentier. Heute möchte sie mit Präsent und Knäckebrot zur Geburt von Tochter „Schneeflöckchen“ gratulieren.

In der Cafeteria des Tierparks muss zwei- bis dreimal im Jahr das riesige Aquarium gereinigt werden. Das Becken ist 1,50 Meter tief, umfasst 25.000 Liter Wasser und beheimatet 21 verschiedene Fischarten. Chefin der Aquarien ist Carla Ruß, die sich für diese Aktion männliche Verstärkung geholt hat: Mirko Klenz, eigentlich Tierpfleger im Greifvogelrevier, wird für sie abtauchen, Algen ausdünnen und Korallenbäumchen aufpfropfen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Panda, Gorilla & Co.
programme.sub-title: Geschichten aus dem Zoo Berlin und dem Tierpark Berlin
programme.desc:
Bei den Aquarianern Marco Hasselmann, Christian Heller und Daniel Strozynski steht der jährliche Ausflug zur Nordsee an. Pünktlich um vier Uhr in der Früh starten sie mit dem Kutter „Stiene Bruhns“ zu einer Tour aufs offene Meer. Mit an Bord: Kapitän Anton Bruhns und Decksmann Timo Borg. Ziel des Unterfangens: Neben Futterfisch sollen viele neue Bewohner für die Schaubecken des Zoo-Aquariums gefangen werden, die im Fisch-Handel nur schwer erhältlich sind. Die ergiebige Beute und eine Robben-Bank vor der Insel Borkum lassen die Herzen der drei Aquarianer höher schlagen.

Eine ganz und gar nicht alltägliche Aktion steht heute auch in den Giraffen-Revieren von Zoo und Tierpark auf dem Plan: Die elf Jahre alte Netzgiraffe Kibaya verlässt den Zoo in Richtung Tierpark. Im Gegenzug wird Bulle Max aus dem Tierpark die Junggesellenherde um Abasi und Mugambi erweitern. Damit der Umzug glatt über die Bühne geht, sind alle verfügbaren Pfleger aus anderen Revieren vor Ort. Eine Schleuse aus Stroh und eine Gasse aus Planen soll Kibaya den Weg hinaus und Max den Weg hinein ins Antilopen-Haus erleichtern. Doch bevor der speziell umgebaute Pferdetransporter sich auf die Fahrt begeben kann, brauchen alle viel Geduld und Zeit.

Doch nicht nur die Giraffen Kibaya und Max müssen Abschied von vertraut gewordenen Pflegern nehmen. Auch das Chaco-Pekari Zamuco wird bald den Tierpark Richtung Tschechien verlassen müssen. Solange es noch möglich ist, schaut seine ehemalige Ziehmutter Jana Simon daher jeden Morgen bei dem 15 Monate alten Zamuco vorbei. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Quarks im Ersten
programme.desc: Rund zehn Prozent der Bevölkerung gelten als immungeschwächt. Oft wird das Immunsystem durch medizinische Behandlungen künstlich unterdrückt. Welche Lösungen gibt es noch? Wir wirkt ein Herbstspaziergang?

programme.title: Die Tierärzte – Retter mit Herz
programme.desc: Engagierte Tierärztinnen und Tierärzte bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit – von Sylt bis Starnberg. Mit viel Erfahrung, Einfühlungsvermögen und detektivischem Gespür kümmern sie sich um die unterschiedlichsten Notfälle. Ob verschluckte Nadeln, Verletzungen nach einem Verkehrsunfall oder gerissene Bänder: Für die Veterinäre zählt jeder einzelne Patient.\n\nNeben spannenden Fällen gibt es auch praktische Tipps für Tierhalter. Wie lassen sich Parasiten frühzeitig erkennen? Welche Impfungen sind für Haustiere wirklich sinnvoll? Die Experten geben hilfreiche Antworten und zeigen, worauf es bei einer verantwortungsvollen Tierhaltung ankommt.

programme.title: Kein Herz für Inder
programme.desc:
Eine Austauschschülerin aus London soll Fiona (Lena Urzendowsky) aus der Isolation helfen. „Wenn die Sandy McCartney heißt, kann nichts schiefgehen“, verspricht Beatles-Fan Erik (Martin Brambach) seiner Frau Charlotte (Aglaia Szyszkowitz). 

Doch Sandy entpuppt sich als Knirps indischer Abstammung: Sacchidananda Char (Zayn Baig) ist ein echter Sonnenschein und fühlt sich bei den Neufunds auf Anhieb wohl. Die wollen den Mini-Maharadscha am liebsten gleich wieder abschieben, haben sie doch genug mit sich selbst zu tun… 

Dass Viviane Andereggens („Simon sagt auf Wiedersehen zu seiner Vorhaut“) Mix aus Culture-Clash-Spaß und Familiendrama wunderbar funktioniert, liegt daran, dass Humor und ernste Untertöne gut ausbalanciert sind und Klischees umschifft werden.

programme.title: Toni, männlich, Hebamme: Baby im Korb
programme.desc:
Geburtshelfer Toni Hasler (Leo Reisinger) erhofft sich, dass er durch ihre Beziehungsschwierigkeiten bald eine Chance bei Luise (Wolke Hegenbarth) hat. Doch dann findet sie einen ausgesetzten Säugling vor ihrer Haustür. Das Kind weckt bei beiden Elterngefühle, was Luises Praxispartner Toni mit Sorge sieht. Während Luise und Sami als Pflegeeltern wieder zueinanderfinden, führt eine Stickerei auf einem Handtuch Toni zur leiblichen Mutter Charlie. 

Bevor Polizei und Jugendamt eingeschaltet werden, will Toni das Findelkind und seine Mutter wieder zusammenbringen. Dabei entdeckt er ein Krankheitsbild, was die Erklärung für die Situation sein könnte. Schnell wird Toni klar, dass die junge Frau seine Hilfe braucht, um selbst für ihr Kind sorgen zu können… 

Zu tragisch wird es auch im neunten und damit vorletzten Film um den patenten und stets hilfsbereiten Geburtshelfer natürlich nicht. Obwohl die Reihe mit dem nächsten Film endet, ist das für Multitalent Leo Reisinger aber kein Grund, Trübsal zu blasen. Stattdessen findet er immer wieder neue Projekte, wie seinen Debütroman "Bavarese".

programme.title: Brisant
programme.desc:
Die besten Geschichten schreibt das Leben.

„Brisant“, das Boulevardmagazin des MDR, greift sie auf und erzählt sie: Luxus und Laster, Klatsch und Tratsch, Lust und Liebe, Show und Unterhaltung, Rat- und Tat-Themen.

Menschen, Mode, Lifestyle, Gesellschaft, Trends, Verbraucherinformationen, aber auch Unglücke, Urteile, Kriminalität, Skurriles, Menschliches und allzu Menschliches – all das steckt in „Brisant“. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Das Wetter im Ersten
programme.desc: Muss ich morgen den Regenschirm einpacken? Oder darf die Sonnenbrille nicht fehlen? Die Antwort liefert „Das Wetter im Ersten“!\n\nOb Sonne, Regen oder ein Mix aus beidem – im aktuellen Wetterbericht erfahren Sie zuverlässig, wie sich die Lage in den kommenden Stunden und Tagen entwickelt. Kompakt, verständlich und immer auf den Punkt bringt „Das Wetter im Ersten“ die wichtigsten Informationen direkt in Ihr Wohnzimmer. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Sportschau
programme.desc:
U. a.: Rot-Weiss Essen – Alemannia Aachen.

Rot-Weiss Essen geht als Tabellendritter in das Duell mit dem Fünften Alemannia Aachen. Mit einem 1:0-Auswärtssieg bei der SG Sonnenhof Großaspach festigte die Mannschaft von Uwe Koschinat zuletzt ihre Position in den Top 3. Auch zuvor hatte Essen gegen Jahn Regensburg mit 1:0 gewonnen. Lediglich im DFB-Pokal musste sich RWE zwischenzeitlich RB Leipzig mit 1:2 geschlagen geben. In der Liga ist Essen seit fünf Heimspielen ungeschlagen.

Alemannia Aachen reist ebenfalls mit Rückenwind an. Das Team von Mersad Selimbegovic setzte sich zuletzt mit 2:1 gegen Preußen Münster durch und feierte damit den dritten Ligasieg in Folge. Zuvor hatte Aachen bereits Stuttgart II (2:1) und Hansa Rostock (2:0) bezwungen. Mit vier Punkten Rückstand auf Essen bietet sich den Kaiserstädtern die Chance, den Anschluss an die Aufstiegsplätze weiter zu festigen.

programme.title: Sportschau
programme.desc:
U. a.: Borussia Dortmund – SV Elversberg. 

Der BVB ist in der Bundesliga nach acht Spieltagen noch ungeschlagen und liegt mit 18 Punkten auf Rang zwei. Zuletzt erkämpfte sich die Mannschaft von Trainer Niko Kovac ein 2:2 beim FC Bayern. Auch international lief es gut: Durch ein 2:1 gegen Real Betis Sevilla feierten die Dortmunder ihren dritten Sieg in der Ligaphase der Champions League. Im DFB-Pokal hatte sich Schwarz-Gelb zuvor mit einem späten 3:2 gegen Werder Bremen für das Achtelfinale qualifiziert.

Elversberg reist dagegen mit wechselhaften Ergebnissen an. Auf das deutliche 0:4 bei RB Leipzig und das überraschende Pokal-Aus gegen Zweitligist Darmstadt 98 (0:2) reagierte der Aufsteiger mit einem überzeugenden 4:1 gegen Mainz 05. Mit 13 Punkten belegt die Mannschaft von Vincent Wagner einen bemerkenswerten siebten Tabellenplatz.

programme.title: Lotto am Samstag
programme.desc: Seit Juli 2013 präsentiert Franziska Reichenbacher jeden Samstag um 19.57 Uhr die kurz zuvor gezogenen Gewinnzahlen von 6 aus 49, die Superzahl, Spiel 77 und die Super 6. Alle Gewinnzahlen der Glücksspirale werden mit einem Laufband eingeblendet.

programme.title: Klein gegen Groß – Das unglaubliche Duell
programme.desc:
Vier Kinder hat „Tatort“-Star Jan Josef Liefers (62) – da kann er sich sicher gut in die jungen Seelen hineindenken. Zusammen mit Filmkollege Axel Prahl sowie den Musikern Peter Maffay und Johannes Oerding stellt er sich in spannenden Duellen den Kids.

Auf den Ninja-Ausnahmesportler Josiah Pippel wartet ein ganz besonderes Kräftemessen. Schon mit 20 gehört er bereits zur Weltspitze seiner Disziplin und konnte seine beeindruckende Laufbahn mit dem Sieg bei „American Ninja Warrior 2026“ krönen. Doch bei „Klein gegen Groß“ wartet eine neue Herausforderung auf ihn: Im „Ninja-Ring-Hangel-Duell“ muss er gegen den 14-jährigen Mika antreten. Wer hangelt sich schneller durch den anspruchsvollen Parcours?

Wissenschaft trifft auf Geschicklichkeit, wenn Mai Thi Nguyen-Kim zum „Moleküle-Duell“ antritt. Die bekannte Wissenschaftsjournalistin begeistert mit ihrem YouTube-Kanal MAIThink X und ihrer gleichnamigen Fernsehsendung ein Millionenpublikum. Normalerweise erklärt sie komplizierte wissenschaftliche Themen auf unterhaltsame Weise. Diesmal muss sie ihr Wissen allerdings selbst unter Beweis stellen. Und auch Palina Rojinski bekommt es mit einer tierisch kniffligen Aufgabe zu tun….

programme.desc:
Nachdem sie auf der Verlobungsfeier von Gwen (Bronagh Gallagher) und Dave (Fritz Karl) einen Eklat verursachte, wird die verbitterte Fiona erschlagen aufgefunden. Die Spuren deuten auf denselben Täter, der auch die Studentin tötete.
